text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan! Holding off an elite field 
of rivals, Mejiro Ardan takes the lead! 
She's across the line! The pinnacle of 
racing has been decided right here, right 
now!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Milady... You are truly magnificent...

...I suppose "next time" will be on the 
turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I won... Me...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I... beat everyone...!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ――Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Congratulations. It's your win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Miss Oguri...! Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"—I've always thought your running was 
truly fascinating."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It's as if she holds so many different 
kinds of brilliance within her, how should 
I put it...—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It was bursting with color, shining like 
delicate glassware.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. At any rate, I just wanted to 
tell you that your running was 
magnificent, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No—it is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing you say that... is a great honor 
for me."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-saaaannn!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That was truly, truly an amazing run! So 
much so that it almost made me forget the 
frustration of losing...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—A complete defeat. And... you have my 
utmost admiration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san, Yaeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, I'll be the one to win next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, I will win—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I'm not giving it up that easily, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Because I'm... your rival!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: You really changed history, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Mejiro Ardan!! You're 
the symbol of this era--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You and Yaeno Muteki were both amazing! 
Together, we're the Big Three!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. And please, never 
forget this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My name is Mejiro Ardan. Standing here 
bathed in countless radiances, the one who 
shines with vivid light "now"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Upon Fuchu, I shall carve my eternal trail 
of light!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Will you stay by my side and support me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy... that all the strength in 
my legs is about to give out... so—

Afterward, as I supported her, we listened 
together to the cheers praising Mejiro 
Ardan.

Before long, having given her all, she 
drifted off to sleep, but even after 
returning to the waiting room, cheers 
continued to echo through the venue—
